title: How I Attended an All-Guy's Mixer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: College student Tokiwa is invited to a mixer by classmate Suou and brings his friends Asagi and Hagi, only to find Suou and her coworkers dressed as handsome men. Suou works at a bar where staff play princely male personas, and the two groups pair off in a gentle romantic comedy.
life_message: Liking someone for who they are, whatever role they play at work, is the root of a good relationship.

content.note: Three gentle couples; Hagi questions his attraction to cross-dressed Kohaku (Wikipedia); a coworker draws erotic BL as a hobby (Wikipedia).
Mixer and cross-dressing bar setting (AniList Bar tag; MangaUpdates Bar/s) (to verify drinking).
